rv.q: This article is more than 14 years old Review Posh – review This article is more than 14 years old Duke of York's, London With even a Tory attacking the "arrogant, posh boys" who run her party, now seems a good time to revive Laura Wade's 2010 play.

Lyndsey Turner ’s production really misses one or two of the original cast – there’s a lack of definition here and there – and it was a common complaint around me in the back stalls that the actors’ articulation and audibility are poor.
